bottlenecks.bottleneck: Attempts pile onto one label while others never get a turn (ADDRESS F1 0 in naive)
bottlenecks.fix: route work by expected gain x node success rate, not just 'worst label'

bottlenecks.bottleneck: Misses and false alarms need opposite fixes, but one prompt mixes them
bottlenecks.fix: separate recall-hunter / precision-guard nodes; route by FN vs FP share

bottlenecks.bottleneck: The model always sees the same fixed failure sample from a fixed test set
bottlenecks.fix: H-step: policy rewrites its own harness (sample size, grouping, focus mode)

bottlenecks.bottleneck: Rare formats (obfuscated emails, +91 phones) have few or no examples
bottlenecks.fix: H-step: policy writes NEW labeled test cases for formats it suspects
